ev.q: Rates of rebound of SARS-CoV-2 RNA shedding, identified based on an increase in nasopharyngeal viral RNA levels from day 5 (end-of-treatment) to day 10 or day 14, were similar between nirmatrelvir/ritonavir and placebo recipients.
viral RNA rebound occurred in 6.4%–8.4% of nirmatrelvir/ritonavir recipients and 5.9%–6.5% of placebo recipients

At either posttreatment timepoint (i.e., day 10 or day 14), viral RNA rebound rates in nirmatrelvir/ritonavir and placebo recipients were 8.3% (77 of 925) and 5.7% (53 of 922), respectively (p = 0.036).
Evaluation of SARS-CoV-2 RNA Rebound After Nirmatrelvir/Ritonavir Treatment in Randomized, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Trials

methods_quotes.q: Exploratory statistical analyses were conducted using two-sided Fisher’s exact tests to provide nominal p-values, without multiplicity adjustments; p<0.05 was considered statistically significant.
rebound rates were compared between nirmatrelvir/ritonavir and placebo recipients who had a virologic response on day 5.
